name: Question 5
problem: Find a vector equation of the straight line passing through $P(5,5,-5)$ and parallel to $v=⟨0,-\sqrt{5},-1⟩.$
worked_solution:
The vector equation of the straight line passing through $P$ and parallel to $v$ is given by

$$
r=p+tv,
$$

where $t\in (-\infty ,\infty )$ and $p$ is the position vector of $P.$

In our case, the position vector of the point $P$ is $p=⟨5,5,-5⟩.$

Using the formula for the vector equation of a line, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}r=⟨5,5,-5⟩+t⟨0,-\sqrt{5},-1⟩,\,t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).\end{aligned}
$$

?

Find a vector equation of the straight line passing through P(5,5,−5) and parallel to v=⟨0,−5,−1⟩.

a
r=⟨−5,5,5⟩+t⟨−1,−5,0⟩,t∈(−∞,∞)
b
